methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
a questionnaire was designed and developed to survey experts’ 
opinions on sub-criteria to be assessed under sustainable energy performance indicators

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Residential building-envelope sustainability assessment. The study ranks sustainability sub-criteria (energy efficiency, material efficiency, environmental impact, external benefit, regulation efficiency) by an expert-questionnaire Relative Importance Index to feed a qualitative building-performance assessment framework. No EnPI/EnB energy measurement or normalisation model is presented or characterised (no energy baseline, no energy-vs-driver regression); the reported regression models inter-respondent opinion consensus (engineers vs other professionals), not energy performance. Buildings context, no industrial component.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
this study has successfully created effective sub-criteria that could be 
assessed under sustainable energy performance indicators to be incorporated for building assessment 
performance methods

stage1.notes: 'Sustainable energy performance indicator' language denotes a sustainability rating category, not an ISO 50006 EnPI. paper_type framework vs methodological/theoretical is borderline; ineligibility is a Tier-1 call for human adjudication.
